input_types: One UTF-8 JSON object conforming to toolbox-portable-research-episode-builder-input-r0 on stdin, capped at 262144 bytes, plus a separately supplied explicit workspace-root CLI argument under ignition/.
required_outputs: One bounded deterministic JSON envelope containing a portable-research-episode-r0 manifest, computed SHA-256 and byte-count receipts, typed findings, total artifact bytes read, and explicit non-authorization/non-write/non-authenticity fields.
On invalid input or unsafe reads, a typed failure result with no manifest; successful assembly alone does not assert manifest validity.
